summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository without committing or running tests. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and a Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title, which buffers the control only when is_terminal and returns True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests were added to tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not verified: tests and Black were not run, per instructions. The non-terminal dropping of control segments relies on existing behavior in Console._render_buffer.
